steps.text: 'The Ends of the Earth' lounge, Lungmen

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: What are you doing here, Exusiai?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uh, what are YOU doing here?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The lounge's closed.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: I just ended up here. Not sure how. An indentured employee's instincts, I suppose.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Thought I might as well clean up, so long as I'm here.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, I'll clean that up!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I saw that they were gifts for me, so I opened them.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: A crystal ball? This must be Bison—wait, MountainDash Logistics has already expanded into Skarphaket?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What is this whole stack of coupon vouchers? 'The more ya buy, the more ya save; the more ya save, the more ya buy'... does Croissant want me to clean out the mall?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sora's Siracusan Tour Live Album 'A Chance Encounter'... did she forget to send a couple of tickets?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Carnevale mask. This one's got to be from Texas…

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's a little tight. Not great.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: This brush…

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Is it a gift from the boss, or does he want me to use it to clean his vinyls for him?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hey, Yith, what kind of hair do you think the brush is made from?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Looks Lupo to me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Say, why are boss and Texas still in Nuova Volsinii when the Carnevale's already over? I got back from Sargon only to find the shop totally empty! Not a soul in sight!

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Texas said she was setting up Penguin Logistics operations over there. As for Emperor...

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: He and his friends have some other matters to attend to... matters besides recording sessions, parties, and employee training.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Gotcha. Well, I guess it's all the same if I report to you.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Give me a sec. I'm almost done filling it out.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Filling what out?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: My leave request!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I want to take a really long break, so I figured I should go through the formal procedures!

spans.text: long break, so I figured I should go through the formal procedures!

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Exusiai?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You know why I took the Sargonian job, right?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Sargon... Mostima was assigned to the area as Legatus, wasn't she?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bingo!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mostima told me that the one who did those things to sis and her is back in Laterano, the one sis hoped would never show his face again...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: She hasn't fully recovered, but she's joined the Curia. Truth or secret, the events of the past have once again brought them together...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The things that I came to Lungmen to find out.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: You're going back to Laterano?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course! Can't very well wait for my sis to come and see me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Texas, Sora, Bison, Croissant... even the boss, of all people, are busy right now. All good things must come to an end, as they say.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Never forget your roots—that's Penguin Logistics corporate culture, isn't it?

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: On display every day... but correct, in principle.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Keep these gifts safe for me. Tell my friends that I'll be back, once everything is taken care of.

steps.name: Yith
steps.text: Is that your ride?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What? No way! I only just decided!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Exusiai.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uh, hi, guys... what's up?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: This just arrived at the office.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Classified files from landship?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I'm exhausted.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I came all this way, only to get caught up in one strange thing after another! My head's spinning.

a.text: 'Good work, but we need to move quicker.'
'Without a second thought, the Curia is treating the explosion as a terror attack targeting the Summit of Nations.'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Who would have thought that a harmless confessional would be a top-notch spy?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Good work. I'll give you a pat on your speakers.

a.text: 'Which is to say, you are a wanted fugitive now.'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: With Vani's help, though, our bombs can now snap three pillars with one blast!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: There's a long way to go, but pick the right pillar, and a bomb like this can topple an entire building!

a.text: 'The shrine is bigger than any building that exists on Terra. You must familiarize yourself with its layout.'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I don't suppose they'll let me in if I say I'm a fervent believer who wants to pay daily respects to it.

a.text: 'The shrine is heavily guarded. Even confessionals cannot easily enter.'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: No big deal!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If there's a problem, find a solution! If there's no problem, make a problem!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: 'Never take a boring order'—that's Penguin Logistics corporate culture!

a.text: 'Your passion and perseverance are extraordinary, but you have a hard time hiding your thoughts. You should not disturb those you know before it is time, even if...'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Even if it's my sister, right?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That only motivates me more. I'll solve this problem, if for no other reason than to see my sis sooner!

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: It's time to go, El.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I know, Vani.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've only met her a couple of times, but when it comes to this, I know I can trust her.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I can already guess what you're worried about, but... well, it's hard to explain the connection between Sanktas. Anyway, no need to worry.

a.text: 'In that case, this confession has come to a close. Have a nice day.'

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Why do comfort bells keep ringing?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: It's the two nurseries up ahead... strange. There should be other Nurturers in charge of them...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: —Ugh!
The giant milk bottles on each side of the corridor suddenly fall, knocking Andoain out cold.

steps.name: Intruder A
steps.text: Situation?

steps.name: Intruder B
steps.text: He's unconscious, but alive.

steps.name: Intruder B
steps.text: What kind of baby would need a milk bottle this big? It's heavy enough to give a full-grown burdenbeast a concussion.

steps.name: Intruder A
steps.text: Anyway, it's for the best. Less commotion this way.

steps.name: Intruder B
steps.text: What do we do next? Do we peek inside, or...?

steps.name: Intruder A
steps.text: This is a strange place...

steps.name: Intruder A
steps.text: You carry him. The rest of you, stay on your guard. We're getting out of this bloody place the way we came in.

steps.name: Intruder A
steps.text: Leader's waiting outside. We'll get this guy to answer our questions once he wakes up.

steps.name: Intruder B
steps.text: Gotcha—
Like a wind from nowhere, the comfort bells that hang quietly in the corridor and nurseries suddenly begin ringing.
It is not a sound to put babies to sleep; it is cacophonous, unceasing, a loud alarm.

steps.name: Intruder A
steps.text: Damn—

steps.name: Shrine Patrol
steps.text: Alert cancelled.

steps.name: Shrine Patrol
steps.text: Clean up the scene. Don't let the children see it. Take Nurturer Andoain to his room.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Andoain! You're awake.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Intruders. But the guards caught them.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Looks like your hunch was right. You were being followed.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: They were after me?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: You're the chosen Nurturer. They must have the Nativity in their sights.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Who are the intruders?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Just some wayward souls.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Wayward... souls?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: What I mean is, I don't know who they are. Our siblings will pick up the investigation.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: You know better than anyone else how important the Nativity is.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Stay safe and enjoy some rest.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Were you frightened?
(Pants anxiously)

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Lean against my arm.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: No need to fear. It's the comfort bells. You will not hear those terrible sounds here...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: No hunter's whistles, no roaring of tuskbeasts, no rumbling of Originium tides.
(Moans weakly)

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I'm here. I'm always here.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I can feel how much you want to keep living with this life within you... as do I.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Soon, soon... everyone will hope for the same. There will be no more fighting, no more conflict. Everyone will join together in Paradise.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Everyone will walk together with you.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: What do you mean, she just vanished without a trace?

steps.name: Panicked Nun
steps.text: We had just cut the wheat. I had everyone take a little break after lunch. She said she wanted to play her cello, and I-I let her...

steps.name: Panicked Nun
steps.text: She came to this leeward ridge, not too far away. We could hear her music all this time, so I-I didn't think too much of it.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Then, when you came to find her, she was nowhere to be seen...

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: What is this? Some kind of paranormal activity?

steps.name: Panicked Nun
steps.text: Paranormal activity... right at the door of a monastery...

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: It would make a nice movie... what I mean is, no need to panic.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: You can still hear the music, can't you? Perhaps Arturia just went deeper into the wheat fields. Musicians can be an unpredictable lot.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Take some and go up front. I'll handle things here.
Examine the other scarecrows, Sister. You should find a device like this on their necks.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Executor Federico of the Notarial Hall. I came for my regular visit of the prisoner Arturia.
The young executor opens his palm. There is a paper dragonfly sitting on it, flapping its wings at a regular frequency to create pleasant music.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: P-Paper dragonfly?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: A form of musical Arts. The prisoner must have learned it in Leithanien.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Sh-She used a page from The Saints' Travels!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: This detail is not important. What is important is I am now certain that Arturia is no longer under observation. She has escaped.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: I... I surmised as much.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Arturia is an important individual, is she not?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Based on the amount of resources that the Notarial Hall has committed, from issuing a warrant to achieving her apprehension—yes.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: L-Landen Monastery has only recently regained its standing with the Curia and gotten out of the red...

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: (And this executor caught us on the spot! There's no way we can quietly bring Arturia back now...)

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I can hear you, Sister.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: A-Anyway, I must report this to the Curia immediately!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There will be no need for that, Sister.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The Notarial Hall will take over from here. I was the one who apprehended Arturia; I will catch her before she can do any true harm.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: There will be no need for Landen Monastery to file a report.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Th-That's not what the procedures say, is it?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: I see... you never intended to report this, did you?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: This is an awfully convenient coincidence. You came for this. You knew Arturia would escape.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: No comment.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Arturia was just like you. It was like she had realized something, and spoke in cryptic terms...

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: If you won't let me report this, senior, then I must join you in your pursuit of Arturia.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Landen Monastery is very important to me. I won't let it come to harm.
The executor flicks deftly with his finger, and the paper dragonfly turns back into a creased page. The music disappears, and the fields are once again quiet.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: What are you doing?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Retaining evidence. The sound it was making would have obstructed our investigation.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Your request complies with the regulations of the Executor's Handbook. I hereby approve the request to join the hunt for the fugitive. Come.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: You're just as strange as Arturia, only in a much different way.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I've seen it standing there like that every day, but when you get up close...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: HOW IS IT SO CRAZY TALL?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: What are these gill-like scales... where do these bone-like passages lead...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And what's with this flowing color on the wall? It's like what you throw up after you eat blueberry pudding made with soup water... I'm getting sick just looking at it.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: How do you know what you throw up after eating blueberry pudding made with soup water?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Just a little practical joke that didn't go the way I intended. Not the most pleasant of memories, but it almost brings a smile, thinking back to it now.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Back then, we could tell the difference between a practical joke and serious stuff, and we didn't build strange structures like this with true blue religious fervor. What even is it, anyway? Some kind of massive biological organ?

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: This place feels familiar. I must have been here before, but I can't tell whether it used to be a bakery, a chapel, or a munitions market.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: It's like this huge shrine has always been here.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: It feels... weird...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Does your head hurt?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's not that hard to understand.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Imagine your favorite patisserie, which you visit once every few days, whether it's for a party, or just because your sweet tooth is aching.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: When you happen to pass by it today, you can't resist.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But when you bite into the mille-feuille you just bought, everything feels different. You wonder if they got a new patissier, then you look up and find the whole storefront is different.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's pretty much just like that, right?

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Y-Yeah... wow, I couldn't put my feelings into words like that at all.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: But when did that mille-feuille become different?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: No idea! It seems to have changed when I got back from Lungmen.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I saw the shrine standing there as soon as I came out of the port.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Say, how did I miss something this big from outside the city?

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Shh—El—

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Over there...

steps.name: Shrine Patrol A
steps.text: All patrols, form up.

steps.name: Shrine Patrol A
steps.text: Guard these halls in three-team squads. Shifts change every three hours.

steps.name: Shrine Patrol A
steps.text: We must not allow any further intrusions into the shrine, no attacks on the Nurturers.

steps.name: Shrine Patrol B
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Since when did the Pontifica Cohors Lateran wear such... distinctive uniforms?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wait, this scaley cape... are these guards just for the Shrine of Nurtury?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: There are too many of them... not sure how to get past. They've blocked off all the paths.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Sarkaz
steps.text: Is this the place where Extra's resting?

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Yes. We can arrange for visits, if you so desire.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Dedicated Nurturers have been assigned to her. She will receive the best possible care until she gives birth.

steps.name: Feline
steps.text: What about us?

steps.name: Feline
steps.text: Thirteen nomadic abbeys, with patients in the four figures. The Pagus Ambrosius you put us in doesn't have that many hospitals or sanatoriums...

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: The Summit of Nations, with all its attendees, has stretched Laterano's medical resources to its limits.

steps.name: Lupo
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: Taking in a pregnant woman already represents exceptional circumstances.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: However, you have come here out of trust in Laterano, and Laterano must repay that trust.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: The Shrine of Nurtury is not scheduled to open to the public until after the Nativity. Most of the rooms are unoccupied at this time, and our Nurturers have received basic medical training.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: The Matriarch has already discussed this with the Curia. The Shrine of Nurtury will take in our friends from outside on a temporary basis, until more permanent arrangements can be made.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: The guards will escort you to your rooms. I must remain here, as more patients are expected to arrive.

steps.name: Nurturer
steps.text: The Lord's blessing be upon Laterano, and upon all.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: See, there's a way.

steps.name: Vannini
steps.text: Don't tell me—
